Maria (CS): ACME reported embedding/rerank quality regression after yesterday's model swap. Top-k precision down ~12% on their eval set (avg query len 230). Latency for long rerank jobs jumped ~40%. Logs attached to ticket #12345.

Leo (Support): Uploading logs + sample prompts to the ticket now. They attached model_id: redwood-embed-v2-qa and rerank pipeline embed->dot->softmax.

Alex (ENG): Thanks. Quick Q: did they change batch sizes or request patterns? @Maria any example traces we can look at?

Maria (CS): No app changes — customer says only thing that flipped was model auto-update. Sample trace: ```
trace_id: abc123
latency_ms: 4200
seq_len: 1024
batch: 1
```

Sara (ML): This smells like a quantization/kernel mismatch for long sequences. v2-qa got an updated kernel selection that may not play well with prefix caching. Do we know variant (int8 vs int16)?

Maria (CS): Ticket metadata: `variant: int8-optim`.

Alex (ENG): Oof. If auto-swapped to int8 that could explain both perf + quality drops. @Sara can you run a quick eval using their prompt set vs our baseline (int8 vs int16)?

Sara (ML): On it. Will run P@k, recall, and latency metrics for both variants. ETA ~2h.

Jon (PM): Priority: high — customer is on Dedicated with committed SLAs. We need a triage decision: rollback variant for them or pin variants while we investigate. Thoughts?

Leo (Support): Customer said they'd accept rollback if it restores quality. They're OK with slightly higher cost.

Alex (ENG): Short-term mitigation: pin their routing to `redwood-embed-v2-qa@stable` forcing int16. That needs a targeted rollback + routing config change. Requires eng hotfix.

Jon (PM): :thumbsup: Propose P0 for today. Acceptance criteria for hotfix: (1) customer precision within 2% of baseline, (2) tail latency < 1.5x baseline, (3) no regressions for other tenants.

triage-bot: Automated note: Created backlog item #PRD-871 with template 'customer-embedding-quality'. Assigned to eng-team.

Alex (ENG): I'll pick up PRD-871. Plan: reproduce internally, validate fix, run cross-tenant canary (10% traffic) for 1h, then full rollout. If unable to reproduce, escalate to model team for rollback.

Maria (CS): I'll coordinate with ACME on rollback window and capture exact KPI targets in ticket.

Sara (ML): Preliminary eval: int8 shows P@10 drop ~11%, int16 matches baseline. Latency delta traced to kernel selection for seq > 512. I'll attach kernel logs and diff.

Jon (PM): For product backlog: add 'variant pinning' feature (API + console control to opt-out of auto-updates). Rough estimate: ~3 sprints for UI+API+policy. Flag as medium priority; tie to Dedicated customer roadmap.

Leo (Support): For immediate runbook: do targeted pin for ACME and document steps in support KB.

Alex (ENG): Agreed. I'll push hotfix branch and request emergency review.

Maria (CS): Thanks — I'll post customer confirmation once rollback window is set.
